text_simplified: Parents must teach their children tawakkul (reliance) upon Allah and seeking His help in all matters, while guiding them towards du'a and trust in Allah. It is also essential to raise children upon good akhlaq (moral character) and warn them against injustice and aggression, as this shapes their personality and behavior in the future.

review_defects.arabic: مع ضرورة توجيههم للدعاء والثقة بالله
review_defects.english: while guiding them towards du'a and trust in Allah
review_defects.why: The Arabic includes 'ضرورة' (necessity), making the guidance an obligation, but the English omits this word, weakening the force.

review_defects.english: It is also essential to raise children
review_defects.why: The Arabic 'ينبغي' means 'should' or 'ought to', a recommendation, but the English 'essential' implies necessity, strengthening the obligation beyond the original.
